note: Chesterfield County SC publishes no queryable zoning district service found. County GIS is a viewer (chesterfieldsc.wthgis.com) with no discoverable REST endpoint (404 on /arcgis/rest/services); the county open data portal lists parcels, streets, addresses and subdivisions, no zoning. Cheraw and the Town of Chesterfield publish zoning only as PDF maps; Pageland publishes its official zoning map as a PDF. ArcGIS searches return only Virginia Chesterfield County zoning layers, which are not this county.
